services.name: Wagon Ride
services.desc: A fall and early winter hay wagon ride through the White River National Forest when the snow just isn't quite deep enough yet. Hay bale seats arranged to fit the size of your party. $55 for Adult and $45 for child (4 to 12) with custom hot chocolate or cider made to order for A Fall Classic with Custom Hot Chocolate or Cider

services.name: Photography Company Add-On
services.desc: The Private Photography Company www.AndTwoWereTamed.com is a separate company added extra to your Private Ride, the photographer will capture your special proposal, anniversary, or just a special day with your family. The photo shoot happens during the sleigh ride and can expand before and after the ride depending on the Photo Package chosen and paid for when the Photographer contacts you, after the reservation of private ride with the Photography Company Add-on Hire a private photographer to capture a special moment. Photo packages start around $500

services.name: Exclusive Romantic Sleigh Ride
services.desc: Check-in is 30 minutes before the tour start time Exclusive Sleigh Ride Our private one-horse open sleigh ride for 2 to 4 is the perfect way to propose, celebrate an anniversary, have an intimate wedding or just snuggle up with those close to you Custom Built Black Sleigh with burgundy leather seats - the swan-bodied sleigh exemplifies the elegance prevalent during the Victorian era. Imagine gliding through an enchanted, snow covered forest in our majestic one-horse open Enjoy a private one-horse open sleigh in the majestic scenery of the Rocky Mountains!

services.name: A Private Ride on the Big Red Sleigh
services.desc: Travel out into the forest on your own large Santa Sleigh, sleigh can hold up to 20. Book this sleigh for your larger family groups. The Big Sleigh takes the 30 minute cocoa ride route but the sleigh is all yours during that Your Own Big Sleigh Ride

services.name: Hot Cocoa Scenic Sleigh Ride
services.desc: Check-in is 20 minutes before the ride start time Scenic Winter Sleigh Ride An afternoon sleigh ride through the Colorado backcountry awaits you at Golden Horseshoe Sleigh Rides.
